items.title: Turkey’s Mobile Puzzle Portfolio Playbook
items.en_oneliner: Nearly $1B has backed Turkey's mobile gaming ecosystem since 2022, with $954M across 112 deals, and this piece breaks down the portfolio playbook of its puzzle game makers.

items.title: Steam's Personal Calendar Full Release
items.en_oneliner: Steam's Personal Calendar has graduated from Steam Labs into a full feature on the store homepage, giving developers a new way to reach players with release and event reminders.

items.title: GameMaker's GMRT runtime will soon be free for all developers
items.en_title: GameMaker's GMRT runtime will soon be free for all developers
items.en_oneliner: GameMaker's GMRT runtime will be free for all developers from 2027, lowering the barrier to commercial development.

items.title: No Source Code? No Problem! What if you have to port a program, but all you have is a binary? (2003)
items.en_title: No Source Code? No Problem! What if you have to port a program, but all you have is a binary? (2003)
items.en_oneliner: A 2003 classic on how to port a program when all you have is the binary, still useful for developers working on retro ports or reverse engineering.
